title: Tokens/sec profiling and tail-latency panels by route/model/region
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: Add tokens-per-second (TPS) profiling and robust p95/p99 tail-latency tracking dashboards sliced by route, model, and region. Deliver an operator-friendly dashboard set and a regression-detection pipeline that surfaces meaningful tail shifts and ties them back to load tests/playbacks.

Background: Existing telemetry captures request latency and basic throughput but lacks a first-class TPS metric and consistent per-slice tail quantiles with drift detection. Teams need: (1) ability to correlate tokens/sec and batching behavior with p95/p99 changes, (2) quick root-cause signals (model variant, region, route), and (3) reproducible load-playback links.

Approach:
- Instrumentation: add token_count and sequence_length tags to the request telemetry span; ensure model_variant, route_name, and region are normalized tags. Emit tokens_per_second as derived metric where possible (tokens / request_processing_seconds) and also as histogram for distribution analysis. Use t-digest for percentile approximation in time-series pipeline to preserve p95/p99 fidelity.
- Aggregation/rollups: compute per-minute and per-5m granular rollups for tokens/sec and HDR/t-digest percentile summaries. Store 90d of minute-level rollups, 365d of daily aggregates.
- Dashboards: deliver a 3-panel view per slice: 1) TPS heatmap (routes x models) with selectable region filter, 2) p95/p99 time-series with overlay of batch size median and tokens/sec, 3) delta view comparing current window vs baseline (7d, 28d). Add violin/boxplot panels for distribution of latencies by batch-size bucket. Provide links to playback harness play buttons for reproducing the workload.
- Regression detection: add a watcher that computes relative change in p95 (median of last 30min vs baseline) and flags if p95 increases >20% AND p99 increases >15% or absolute p99 > 3x baseline. Use adaptive thresholds per-route derived from historical variance. Alerts post to PagerDuty and create a prefilled ticket with suggested repro playbook.
- Load harness integration: expand the existing load harness to emit token-level traces and to annotate runs with run_id, scenario_name, and expected-percentiles. Store playback artifacts and attach run_id to any regression alert to enable one-click reproduction.
- Acceptance criteria:
  * New TPS metric emitted for >=90% of production traffic within rollout window.
  * Dashboards populated with 90 days of rollups and show per-route/model/region selectors.
  * Regression watcher triggers on synthetic regressions from the harness and attaches run_id with suggested mitigation steps.
  * Runbook created with steps to reproduce, degrade, and rollback model variants.

Rollout plan: Canary instrumentation in us-west-2 on non-critical endpoints for 48h, validate signal quality with replay runs, then fleet rollout over two weeks. Coordinate with Dedicated/Private infra teams for on-prem telemetry adapters.

Risks and mitigation:
- Metric cardinality explosion: normalize route and model tags and use tagging whitelist.
- Percentile noise for low-traffic slices: fallback to aggregated rollups and require min-sample gates for alerts.
- Storage costs: retention tiers and downsampling strategy.

Notes: This ticket focuses on the telemetry and dashboarding work; model tuning or batcher algorithm changes will be tracked as followups with clear links to reproductions found by this work.
